title: PrefO2O: Zero-Shot Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning via Offline-to-Online Latent Preference Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.31812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for learning robot behaviors aligned with human intent. However, its scalability is fundamentally limited by the need to collect expensive human preference labels for every new task. In this work, we present PrefO2O, an offline-to-online latent preference transfer framework that enables zero-shot PbRL on unseen target tasks without requiring any human feedback. The core idea is to learn a task-invariant latent preference space from a small amount of offline preference data on source tasks, where transferable preference structures are disentangled from task-specific variations. This learned manifold allows PrefO2O to transfer preference structures and reward priors to new tasks under distribution shift, while confidence-weighted optimal transport alignment generates reliable pseudo-preference supervision for online reward adaptation. Extensive experiments

translated_title: PrefO2O：通过离线到在线潜在偏好迁移实现零样本基于偏好的强化学习
translated_abstract: 基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）已成为一种有前景的范式，用于学习与人类意图一致的机器人行为。然而，其可扩展性受到根本性限制，因为每个新任务都需要收集昂贵的人类偏好标签。在这项工作中，我们提出了PrefO2O，这是一个离线到在线的潜在偏好迁移框架，能够在无需任何人类反馈的情况下，在未见过的目标任务上实现零样本PbRL。其核心思想是从源任务的少量离线偏好数据中学习一个任务不变的潜在偏好空间，在其中将可迁移的偏好结构与任务特定的变化解耦。学习到的这一流形使PrefO2O能够在分布偏移下将偏好结构和奖励先验迁移到新任务，同时通过置信度加权的最优传输对齐为在线奖励适应生成可靠的伪偏好监督。大量实验……
tldr: 提出PrefO2O框架，通过从源任务少量离线偏好数据中学习任务不变的潜在偏好空间，并利用置信度加权最优传输对齐进行在线奖励适应，实现了无需任何人类反馈的零样本基于偏好的强化学习。
en_tdlr: PrefO2O enables zero-shot preference-based reinforcement learning on unseen tasks without any human feedback by learning a task-invariant latent preference space from offline source-task data and using confidence-weighted optimal transport alignment for online reward adaptation.
